## Summary

Describe the change and the user-visible result.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Security / reliability
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Publisher / deployment
- [ ] Refactor

## Verification

- [ ] Tests pass locally or in CI
- [ ] No secrets or credentials were added
- [ ] Public links / routes were checked
- [ ] Screenshots or output are attached when the change is visual
- [ ] Rollback is straightforward

## Deployment notes

Describe any environment variables, migrations, external services, or manual steps.

## Evidence

Link the relevant workflow run, screenshot, benchmark, or public verification.
